title: Veridone configuration
description: Configuration for the Veridone Claude Code plugin: .claude/veridone.json (shared), .claude/veridone.local.json (personal), ~/.claude/veridone.json (user) and ~/.claude/veridone-policy.json (organization policy, Team plan).

globList.description: Glob patterns (**, *, ?, [abc], {a,b}); a pattern without '/' matches the file name anywhere.

mode.description: strict: medium integrity findings block, the gate needs tests + typecheck on the full suite. standard: high findings block, the gate needs the primary check. relaxed: findings warn, only false claims are challenged. off: Veridone does nothing.

locked.description: Organization policy only (Team plan): when true, the policy's mode wins over session modes and environment overrides.

rules.description: Override the level of individual guard rules, e.g. {"publish-release": "off", "git-force-push-protected": "deny"}. See docs/rules.md.

allowCommands.description: Regular expressions; a Bash command matching one is never guarded.

protectedBranches.description: Branches where force-pushes need confirmation (added to the defaults).

disposableDirs.description: Directory names that are safe to delete (build output, caches).

sensitiveFiles.description: Files whose contents must not be read into the conversation.

deny.description: Paths the agent may never edit.

ask.description: Paths that need confirmation before an edit (lockfiles, vendored code).

guardrailFiles.description: Hook/permission/safety configuration the agent must not change on its own.

migrationDirs.description: Where database migrations live; editing a committed migration needs confirmation.

scanScripts.description: Also analyze local shell scripts the agent runs (./deploy.sh).

customRules.description: Team command rules (Pro). Matched against the whole Bash command line.

block.description: Deny writes that add high-confidence credentials to source files.

allowFiles.description: Files where credential-looking values are expected (test fixtures).

rules.description: Override the action of individual integrity rules, e.g. {"console-log": "off", "any-cast": "warn"}. See docs/rules.md.

ignore.description: Paths never scanned (added to the defaults).

customRules.description: Team code rules (Pro). Matched against lines an edit adds.

stopGate.description: Ask Claude to verify (or disclose) before finishing a turn that changed code.

claimCheck.description: Challenge 'all tests pass'-style claims that the session's evidence contradicts.

commands.description: Override detected verification commands. Use null or "" to disable a category.

require.description: Checks that must pass after the last change before Claude finishes. auto: test (or typecheck/build); strict mode adds typecheck.

ignore.description: Changed files that never require verification (docs, images).

onStart.description: Tell Claude the verification commands at session start.

afterCompact.description: Restore a session brief after context compaction or on resume.
